table.name: Other_Available_Features
table.purpose: Lookup table of optional property features (e.g. air conditioning, swimming pool, burglar alarm), each classified by feature type (Amenity or Security), that can be attached to properties via Other_Property_Features. Note: rows start at id 2, suggesting row 1 was deleted or the sequence started there; the full feature list is likely larger than these 3 rows suggest, but only 3 exist here.

col_001.name: feature_id
col_001.description: Primary key of the feature; surrogate BIGINT id referenced by Other_Property_Features.col_002 to link properties to features.

col_002.name: feature_type
col_002.description: Category of the feature, a foreign key to Ref_Feature_Types (values: Amenity, e.g. Pool; Security, e.g. Burglar Alarm).

col_003.name: feature_code
col_003.description: Short machine-friendly code name of the feature (AirCon, Pool, BurglarAlarm).

col_004.name: feature_description
col_004.description: Human-readable display name/description of the feature (Air Conditioning., Swimming Pool., Burglar Alarm).

table.name: Other_Property_Features
table.purpose: Junction/association table linking properties (Properties) to their available features (Other_Available_Features), with a free-text note per row. Each row represents one feature attached to one property.

col_001.name: property_id
col_001.description: Reference to Properties.col_001 (the property the feature belongs to). Many-to-one: multiple feature rows can point to the same property.

col_002.name: feature_id
col_002.description: Reference to Other_Available_Features.col_001 (the feature attached to the property). Lookup labels suggest feature categories such as Amenity and Security.

col_003.name: note
col_003.description: Free-text note attached to the property-feature pair. Values are Latin-like filler words (e.g. 'quo', 'autem', 'corrupti'), so the actual semantic content cannot be determined from the data; it is a short text field, possibly a comment or placeholder.

table.name: Properties
table.purpose: Real-estate property listings: one row per property with its type, dates, name, address, and various numeric attributes. Referenced by a property-features table.

col_001.name: property_id
col_001.description: Primary key, unique integer identifier of the property; referenced by Other_Property_Features.

col_002.name: property_type
col_002.description: Category of the property (House, Apartment, Shop, Field, Other); foreign key to Ref_Property_Types lookup.

col_003.name: created_at
col_003.description: Timestamp, likely record creation/listing date. Could also be an acquisition or registration date; exact semantics unresolved.

col_004.name: updated_at
col_004.description: Second timestamp per property; plausibly last-updated date, but could be another event date (e.g. sale/inspection). Unresolved which.

col_005.name: property_name
col_005.description: Short unique name/label of the property (e.g. 'avalon', 'high line').

col_006.name: address
col_006.description: Full postal address (street, city, state, ZIP) of the property.

table.name: Ref_Feature_Types
table.purpose: Small lookup/reference table classifying property features into broad types (Amenity, Security), each with a description and example. Referenced by Other_Available_Features to categorize its feature rows.

col_001.name: feature_type
col_001.description: Short code/label for the feature category: 'Amenity' or 'Security'. Primary key of this lookup table; referenced by Other_Available_Features.col_002 to classify each available feature.

col_002.name: feature_type_description
col_002.description: Human-readable description of the feature type with an example ('Amenity, eg Pool.', 'Securiyt, eg Burglar Alarm.' — note the typo 'Securiyt' in the source data).

table.name: Ref_Property_Types
table.purpose: Lookup/reference table of property type categories used to classify properties in the Properties table. Each row is one property type with a short code/label and a longer description of what it covers.

col_001.name: property_type
col_001.description: Short label of the property type category (Apartment, Field, House, Other, Shop). Primary key of this lookup table; referenced by Properties.col_002 to classify each property.

col_002.name: property_type_description
col_002.description: Longer description of what each property type category includes, e.g. 'House, Bungalow, etc.' or 'Shop, Retail Outlet.'.
